claims.claim: At June 30, 2026 ADM reported $23.6 billion of shareholders' equity and $12.6 billion of credit lines, with $10.0 billion unused.
ADM had $1.1 billion of cash and cash equivalents at June 30, 2026 and cited $5.6 billion of unused available U.S. credit capacity.
Only $30 million of commercial paper was outstanding against programs supported by $5.1 billion of total lines of credit.

risks.risk: A substantial portion of liquidity is committed credit capacity rather than cash on hand; availability does not itself establish future operating profitability or commodity-cycle resilience.

contradictions.contradiction: ADM carries only $1.1B cash while reporting $10.0B unused credit lines, indicating meaningful liquidity capacity but material reliance on financing access rather than cash alone.

unknowns.unknown: Scout does not convert liquidity capacity into Alpha numeric underwriting, risk or data-confidence values.
This source excerpt does not establish future borrowing costs or stress-case facility availability.
